newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU strips Burma of trading privileges.
newsitem.headline: EU strips Burma of trading privileges.

text.p: The European Union decided on Monday to strip Burma of special trading privileges in response to concerns over Rangoon's human rights record.
EU dipomats said the decision was rubber stamped by a meeting of the 15-nation bloc's foreign ministers.

The decision had been prepared in advance, following advice from the European Commission which has investigated - it says without Rangoon's cooperation -- complaints from international and European non-governmental groups that Burma was using forced labour to boost its exports.
Under the decision Burma will no longer be eligible for so-called Generalised System of Preferences (GSP) trade benefits on agricultural and industrial products.
EU-Burma trade totals around 41 million European currency units ($47.2 million) a year. About a quarter of that is subject to lucrative GSP trade breaks.
